summary: FP4-CSF checkpoints load through FlashInfer's new B12X CSF path, including checkpoints in the csf_32x2_v1 block encoding
compatibility: No user action required. Checkpoints with slab CSF scales keep loading; csf_32x2_v1 checkpoints now load as well.
details: Restores the CSF block loader (84c0704f8f and 3a947437cf), reverted on 2026-10-14 while the image's FlashInfer lacked b12x.loader._csf_source and b12x.loader._csf_blocks. The canonical FlashInfer branch now carries FlashInfer main, which ships them.

Compressed scales are prepared on CUDA and expanded into native scale buffers before the expert GEMMs instead of being decoded inline. On GLM-5.3-Flash TP2 (RTX PRO 6000) the weights load in 83 s instead of 100 s and take 0.54 GiB less per GPU; decode at eight concurrent requests is about 7% slower per step, which is being investigated.
